### Windows acceptance completed — November 4, 2026

[Published qualification](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/7272f78dcc486c4ff592002251a173c1798f25ac/docs/archived/windows-sqlite-final-qualification-2026-11-04.md) and [lossless machine receipt](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/7272f78dcc486c4ff592002251a173c1798f25ac/docs/archived/windows-sqlite-final-qualification-2026-11-04.json) complete this issue at clean execution source `1d53c5262a478708b5b9e9ac33bf905d5a07a45e`.

- All **324 fresh serial children pass** under30-second deadlines, zero retries/native redo, with no failures, timeouts or native crashes.
- Five row-shape cohorts retain all **30 paired trials,60 arms and132 measured samples**. Every complete native mutation has independent full validation; all chunks, postings, file identities, lengths, filter facts and positive FTS results agree.
- Six alternating artifact pairs complete12 builds of32,768 wide rows each: **157,934,386 actual input bytes**, above the unchanged128MiB optimization threshold. Actual current/baseline pragma differences and complete output parity are recorded.
- Original workload admission, transactions, threshold, positive queries and negatives remain. Both indexed source hits precede the latency fixture's20 warm samples; its raw p95=104.3004ms passes the unchanged7500ms bound. The concurrent formatter excludes an isolated speedup claim.
- Real owner counterfactuals establish and repair repeated stale-postings scans and128 per-row writes per page. Original failed campaigns, all raw samples and exact input/command/exit/cleanup evidence remain preserved.
- All eight publication checks pass, including41 gate cases. Optional sqlite-vec, other-platform and broader release qualification remain separate.

The earlier review and original report below are retained as historical requirements and evidence.

### Closeout review — 2026-10-26

**Status: Partial implementation or follow-up acceptance remains.**

Work needed before closure:

- [ ] Qualify representative SQLite indexed workloads and repeated serial trials, proving both expected source hits before warm samples.
- [ ] Retain the strengthened latency thresholds, raw distributions and source/backend/cold-warm identity; helper microbenchmarks alone are insufficient.
- [ ] Qualify the requested resource/work or latency evidence with meaningful inputs; run actual measurements serially and retain raw samples.
- [ ] Pass the related existing checks and the complete original/follow-up acceptance on the resulting candidate; preserve positive and negative controls.

Current source owners: [`tools/bench/sqlite/shared.js`](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/accf98f64a560a5df9b1bdb175f7ca22331672af/tools/bench/sqlite/shared.js), [`src/storage/sqlite/build/from-bundles.js`](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/accf98f64a560a5df9b1bdb175f7ca22331672af/src/storage/sqlite/build/from-bundles.js), [`src/storage/sqlite/build/incremental-update.js`](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/accf98f64a560a5df9b1bdb175f7ca22331672af/src/storage/sqlite/build/incremental-update.js).

Related checks (starting points; not execution evidence): `perf/tooling/bench/sqlite-benchmark-cli/update-current`, `perf/tooling/bench/sqlite-fixture-admission`, `storage/sqlite/build/incremental-bundle-path-guard`, `storage/sqlite/build/multi-row-build-parity`.

Keep this issue open until its original requirements and follow-up acceptance are demonstrated on the resulting candidate.

## Current benchmark paths cannot admit their generated fixtures

PR #572 head `2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5`.

The SQLite bundle-build and incremental-update benchmarks construct manifests without the required artifact surface version. Both production entry points now run exact manifest-format admission before doing database work, so these generated workloads are rejected rather than measuring the selected implementations. Adding the version to the shared factory alone is insufficient: the incremental script rebuilds a new manifest that drops it, and its changed bundle still lacks the immutable snapshot inventory required by the incremental planner.

This is source-proven executable/fixture incompatibility, **not a complaint that planned validation has not run**. No PoC benchmark was executed in the incomplete audit copy.

## Pinned failure chain

1. [`createSqliteBenchBundleFixture`](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/tools/bench/sqlite/shared.js#L53-L95) initializes `const manifest = { files: {} }` and writes `bundle-*.json` entries with no `artifactSurfaceVersion` or selected `bundleInventory`.
2. Both [`buildDatabaseFromBundles`](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/src/storage/sqlite/build/from-bundles.js#L115-L121) and [`incrementalUpdateDatabase`](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/src/storage/sqlite/build/incremental-update.js#L157-L165) invoke `prepareCachedSemanticPlan` before ordinary ingestion/update.
3. [`prepareCachedSemanticPlan`](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/src/storage/sqlite/semantic/from-cache.js#L14-L21) checks `manifest.artifactSurfaceVersion` **before** returning null for a non-semantic fixture. The [exact format gate](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/src/contracts/index-format.js#L8-L34) rejects missing versions as `ERR_INDEX_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED`. Disabling semantic facts does not bypass that requirement, nor should it.
4. Independently, [`incremental-update.js` lines 36–49](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/tools/bench/sqlite/incremental-update.js#L36-L49) creates `updatedManifest = { files: ... }`, dropping top-level identity even if the common fixture is repaired. Its changed entry points to `bundle-changed.json` without a snapshot inventory.
5. After fixing those version boundaries, the [incremental planner](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/src/storage/sqlite/build/incremental-update/planner.js#L128-L150) calls `readIncrementalBundleSnapshot`. That [reader](https://github.com/doublemover/PairOfCleats/blob/2bd168e50d2032045478767e3a0188762a5816f5/src/index/build/incremental/bundle-snapshot.js#L37-L66) requires the complete selected inventory and content-addressed snapshot names; this fixture returns null, so the update is skipped as an invalid bundle. A format-only patch would therefore reveal, not fix, the second barrier.

## Fix the workload, not production admission

Use the current canonical manifest/snapshot producer (or a small shared fixture owner that genuinely follows that producer contract). Preserve top-level format and applicable semantic/capability identity when deriving the updated manifest; publish a new complete changed-bundle snapshot and inventory bound to its exact source metadata. Keep source/path/hash/dependency/format checks enabled. Do not add a benchmark-only loader bypass, relax integrity, or relabel a skipped/full-rebuild path as an incremental measurement.

## Make successful measurements useful

The current defaults are only **20×6 = 120 chunks** for bundle building and **12×6 = 72 starting chunks, one changed six-chunk file** for incremental updating. Increasing `--files` alone still changes only that one file. Each arm runs once in fixed baseline-then-current order; the fixture has two tokens per chunk and no vector/phrase/chargram work. These are reasonable smoke sizes, not sufficient default evidence of sustained batched/WAL or broad incremental throughput gains.

Keep a cheap smoke preset, then add explicitly scoped qualification profiles that vary:
- changed files/rows separately from total repository files, including new/deleted/shrinking/growing files and repeated updates;
- enough actual rows/bytes/batches to cross the selected ingest-plan thresholds, with observed counters rather than only printed planned batch sizes;
- token/vocabulary distribution and optional dense/phrase/chargram lanes only when making claims about those lanes;
- repeated independent database copies/trials, alternated arm order, separately identified setup/build/update/validation/checkpoint timing and declared warm/cold conditions.

Do not weaken the all-or-nothing incremental transaction to manufacture more transactions for a benchmark.

## Acceptance

1. Under the pinned runtime and valid bootstrap, run both benchmark entry points in baseline/current/compare modes. Each must reach actual work and produce the intended build/update count, with no format refusal, invalid-bundle skip, or fallback disguised as success.
2. Assert nonzero expected mutations and compare stable resulting chunks, postings, file manifest and applicable vector/filter facts outside the timed region; existence of a database file alone is not output parity. Validate that the incremental case differs from its starting database exactly as requested.
3. Add a cheap shared-fixture contract test that sends the emitted initial and updated manifests through production admission. A version bump or snapshot contract change must invalidate the benchmark fixture test, not silently strand the benchmark.
4. Smoke output must identify itself as smoke. Performance output must report actual files/rows/postings/bytes processed, realized statement/batch work and sufficient repeated duration; emit a delta only for comparable successful workloads.

## Deduplication / scope

All-state backlog checked for these benchmark paths, snapshot inventory and format-fixture mismatch. #908 owns production bundle/source authority and must remain enforced; #1449 owns records identity, #1108 WAL lifecycle, and #1727 tinybench baseline compatibility. This issue owns the two SQLite bundle benchmark fixtures and their ability to perform representative measured work. Relevant blobs were matched to the current head. No native dependency installation or project execution was used to establish this source finding.

limits: 1384/1413 retain excluded editor portions;1767 retains physical POSIX filenames;1627 needs compatible maintained native binding and actual Windows rebuild/readback.
